text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The year is ending in spectacular fashion with the Arima Kinen, where fans crowd the racecourse for the long-awaited sisterly showdown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thinking of all the strong racers she's faced until now, Narita Brian has realized that strength is the ability to stand back up even when you're feeling your lowest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She goes into the race determined to keep moving forward with that kind of strength.
